tasks.title: Inventory declared scope with exclusions before reads
tasks.goal: Build a pure brownfield inventory that cannot observe excluded or unsafe paths.
steps: Define the inventory request using a trusted root, explicit include/exclude rules and supported source kinds; create the relevant PROP-062 inventory anchors.
Apply exclusions before opening/statting content; retain separate absent/unreadable/unsafe/skipped reasons and bounded file metadata.
Return an in-memory deterministic inventory with no cache/state/lock creation, native analyzers or network.
positive_cases: Included files are enumerated deterministically with source identity.
Excluded sensitive/unreadable subtrees trigger zero reader calls.
negative_cases: Traversal, unsafe links and unbounded requested scope refuse or report explicit skipped/partial status.
Observe cannot create .vibe state, run tools or silently read excluded content.
acceptance: Reader instrumentation proves exclusion-before-read and query purity.
Every omitted path category has a typed reason and completeness impact.
tasks.safe_stop: Pure inventory works; no proposal or promotion performed.
tasks.commit_subject: feat(brownfield): inventory declared scope without hidden effects
notes: PROP-062/fixtures/next/brownfield are proposed paths. M-11-D may independently establish its transition section; do not make inventory a dependency of that pulled-forward atom.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

tasks.title: Capture file witnesses and directory membership
tasks.goal: Make brownfield observations honest under changing files and tree membership.
steps: Add per-file captured bytes/digests and enumeration membership witnesses with explicit observation window and provenance.
Detect content, size, identity and selected directory-entry changes around capture; report unstable rather than combine incompatible states.
Expose a generated complete/partial/unstable inventory report through M-16 snapshot identities and retain no false atomic-global-snapshot claim.
positive_cases: Stable declared scope yields reproducible file/membership witnesses.
Unsupported or skipped scope remains inspectable with explicit incompleteness.
negative_cases: Same-length mutation, new/deleted selected file or alias replacement invalidates the capture.
A successful individual file read cannot certify a mixed-time tree.
acceptance: Mutation fixtures force unstable/incomplete rather than a guessed current inventory.
Metadata/provenance distinguishes capture from live applicability.
tasks.safe_stop: Bounded captured inventory is ready for an analyzer.
